Earthquake impacts mapping from drone data in Nepal (Gairagaun, Pubichauki rural municipality ward-3, Doti) from GLOBHE Crowddroner. The dataset includes high-resolution actionable drone data showing the area impacted from the earthquakes of early November 2022.
